name: Hamiora Te Rauparaha
bio:
Hamiora's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a burning passion for engines, but through a fascination with brand storytelling. After years crafting campaigns for FMCG brands, he saw an opportunity to bring a more dynamic and engaging narrative to the somewhat stuffy world of motorsport marketing. He joined Prema Junior three years ago, initially drawn by their commitment to nurturing young talent. 

His approach blends traditional marketing principles with a keen understanding of the digital landscape. Hamiora is relentless in pursuing innovative ways to connect with fans, from leveraging social media trends to developing interactive fan experiences. While some find his demanding nature challenging, his drive and creative vision are undeniable assets to the team. He believes in pushing boundaries and constantly questioning the status quo, ensuring Prema Junior's brand remains fresh and relevant.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A powerfully built man with a warm smile despite his intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas scribbled in Māori.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought, which can be distracting.
Insists on having a traditional Māori carving on his desk for good luck and inspiration.
